beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Milan joins inherited house authority to contemporary systems of staging, craft, platform distribution, wholesale and traceability. This chapter follows backstage coordination: The same field that helps a show run—a name, measurement, image, availability or location—can also make labor newly trackable and extractable.
beats.onScreen: Then: In March 2020 CNMI said Milan’s 800 showrooms would participate in new B2B and B2C storytelling as menswear moved to September.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: In March 2020 CNMI said Milan’s 800 showrooms would participate in new B2B and B2C storytelling as menswear moved to September. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: CNMI’s Fashion Showroom surface makes market discovery public, but does not expose private orders, prices, sell-through or customer records.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: Which wholesale, ERP or clienteling system converts any named future show into orders remains private unless a brand or vendor documents it.
